<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/process-paths"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Seeds a ProcessPath read model (id, name, an ordered non-empty list of step process types) directly, since there is no event-driven sync from process-path-management yet (a later phase). Re-posting an existing id replaces the stored path wholesale.


<Heading
  id={"request"}
  as={"h2"}
  className={"openapi-tabs__heading"}
>
  <Translate id="theme.openapi.request.title">Request</Translate>
</Heading>

<ParamsDetails
  parameters={[{"name":"Idempotency-Key","in":"header","required":true,"description":"Client-generated key (1-128 printable ASCII characters, normally a UUID) per LOGICAL submit. A retry reuses it; a new user action mints a new one. The service always runs against Postgres (ADR 0016), so the key is required on every POST/PATCH. A missing key is 400 idempotency-key-required, a malformed one 400 idempotency-key-invalid; the same key with a different method, path or body is 409 idempotency-key-reused; the same key with the same request replays the stored answer with Idempotency-Replayed: true.\n","schema":{"type":"string","minLength":1,"maxLength":128}}]}
>
  
</ParamsDetails>

<RequestSchema
  title={"Body"}
  body={{"required":true,"content":{"application/json":{"schema":{"type":"object","required":["id","name","steps"],"properties":{"id":{"type":"string","example":"pick-rebin-pack"},"name":{"type":"string","example":"Pick-Rebin-Pack"},"steps":{"type":"array","minItems":1,"items":{"type":"string"},"example":["PICK","REBIN","PACK"]}},"title":"RegisterProcessPathRequest"}}}}}
>
  
</RequestSchema>
